cases.label: REFUSE: mode=post path outside project
cases.text: bb_index mode=post: refusing a path outside the project. "/etc" resolves to /etc, which is not inside $HOME/mcp/backbencher-brain/validation/tools/bb_index/work/t0-polyglot. bb_index indexes THIS project's files; an out-of-tree path would be stored with a "project-relative" path that is not relative to anything, and every scoped query, file name and freshness check in the index would then be wrong for it.

cases.label: REFUSE: mode=post with a file path
cases.text: bb_index mode=post: $HOME/mcp/backbencher-brain/validation/tools/bb_index/work/t0-polyglot/README.md is a file — mode=post re-derives the phases of the PROJECT, so `path` must be the project root or a directory inside it (pass the project path or ".").

bbIndex.pathDescription: Project-relative file (reindex only that file) or directory (incremental index of changed files); for mode=post, the project root or a directory inside it whose derived phases should be re-run (a file path is refused). REQUIRED in every mode and checked rather than ignored. Must resolve INSIDE the project: both sides are resolved through realpath, so a symlink inside the project pointing out of it is refused too.
